instruction.text: Read the paragraph. Decide if the heading is suitable.

atoms.a:
Paella

This is a traditional Spanish food, which is usually made up of rice, meat and vegetables. It is very popular all over Spain.

Monkeys

This is a way to travel that is better for the environment than cars. A lot of people are now travelling this way.

School

This is a hot country in Europe where a lot of people like to go on holiday. If you are going here, you need to remember your sunscreen.

Exercise

There are lots of different ways to do this. Many people enjoy jogging, or going to the gym.

Flowers

People like getting these as presents, and they grow outside. Most of them grow better in the sun. There are many different types.

Holiday

This is a type of pastry which is very popular in France. It has a lemon flavour and usually has icing on top.

Technology

This is always advancing and useful for almost everything we do. It also means we can be on social media.
